set.body: Implements docs/plans/terminal-workspace.md. A local viewer launched with connect --view or view shares observations with the agent via workspace snapshots and independent activity cursors. Scope: project/root identity, bounded file and log browsing, job-artifact links, remote-only observation, visible staleness, and terminal lifecycle. Reuses the WP8a journal and observer. V1-V4 and exact-candidate local/UI/live qualification are complete; see docs/qualification/activity-observation.md. Hosted CI, publication and release remain separate and unperformed.
